stage_2_story.text_en:
Rami had been looking for a new job for two months. He updated his resume, gathered his references, and finally got an interview at a large marketing company in the city centre.

The night before, Rami prepared carefully. He ironed his shirt, read about the company online, and set three alarms so he would be punctual. He knew that arriving on time was essential.

The interview started at ten o'clock. The manager, a woman named Ms Cohen, asked Rami about his qualifications and his previous responsibilities. Rami spoke confidently. He described how he had shown initiative in his last job — he had noticed a problem with the team's workflow and suggested a solution that saved the company a lot of time.

Ms Cohen also asked how Rami handled deadlines under pressure. He explained that he always planned ahead and communicated with his team to make sure nothing was missed.

At the end, she mentioned that the position came with a three-month probation period. She also said the salary was fixed, but Rami politely tried to negotiate a small increase based on his experience. Ms Cohen said she would consider it.

Two days later, Rami received a phone call with a job offer. The company agreed to his salary request. He accepted immediately and felt proud — all the preparation had paid off.

questions.question: How long had Rami been looking for a new job?
What did Rami do the night before the interview?
options: (a) He called his references to prepare them
(b) He ironed his shirt, read about the company, and set three alarms
(c) He practised answers with his wife
(d) He printed extra copies of his resume

questions.question: Why did Rami set three alarms?
options: (a) Because he had three meetings that morning
(b) Because the interview was very early
(c) Because he wanted to be punctual
(d) Because he was nervous and could not sleep

questions.question: Who interviewed Rami?
options: (c) The head of the sales department

questions.question: What example of initiative did Rami describe?
options: (a) He trained new employees without being asked
(c) He noticed a workflow problem and suggested a solution
(d) He completed a project two weeks early

questions.question: How did Rami say he handles deadlines under pressure?
options: (a) He asks his manager for an extension
(b) He works alone until everything is done
(c) He delegates the work to junior staff
(d) He plans ahead and communicates with his team

questions.question: What did Ms Cohen say about the probation period?
options: (b) The probation period was six months
(c) The probation period was three months
(d) The probation period was one year

questions.question: What did Rami try to negotiate?
options: (d) The option to work from home

questions.question: When did Rami receive the job offer?
options: (a) At the end of the interview

questions.question: Did the company agree to Rami's salary request?
options: (a) No, they refused and kept the original offer
(b) Yes, they agreed to his request
(c) They offered him a smaller increase than he asked for
(d) They said they would decide after the probation period
